title: list-view addRecord: the page host serves no onCreate, so a page node's Add button is withheld
body:
## Problem

A `list-view` page node's `addRecord` has no create path in the console. Two places show it:

1. **Page host.** `packages/app-shell/src/views/pageRecordActions.ts` `pageRelatedHandlers` returns the frozen `NO_RELATED_HANDLERS` whenever `input.parentId` is empty (line 41 on `main`), and under a parent it serves only `onRowAction` / `onToolbarAction`. So a page `list-view` node, which resolves with `{ objectName }` only, gets no `onCreate`. The objectui#12870 pin's CONTROL row asserts "no New" on a page list.
2. **Console object list.** `renderListView` passes `addRecord` without `onAddRecord`. This is a source reading by the PR #13087 contract review and has not been measured.

objectui#13074 (PR #13087) publishes only `requiredPermissions`. `addRecord` stays unpublished, its parity row reworded to "the button is withheld on a page node". The block-level routing contract (`useRelatedRecordActions().resolve({ objectName }).onCreate`) is pinned by the block's own tests, so this card only has to make a host serve it.

## Target

Product decision objectui#11111 decision 3 = B, and the target of objectui#13074: `addRecord` on a page node opens the create flow the object list uses.

- `servePageRecordActions` / `pageRelatedHandlers` serve the bridge's `onCreate` / `createDisabled` for a list with no parent in scope.
- Re-examine the objectui#12870 CONTROL row ("no New") as part of this change. That row was written deliberately, so the change it pins is a decision this card takes knowingly.
- Add a pin through the real `PageView`, in the shape of the objectui#12870 file: clicking a page `list-view` node's Add button pushes `form=new` + `formObject`.
- Then publish `list-view.addRecord` (registry input, struck from `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS`, member pin, docs).
- Measure item 2 and fix it in the same pass when it holds (same class of fault).
- Note: page `openChildForm` ignores `editMode: 'page'`; handle it once `onCreate` is served.

## Surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/pageRecordActions.ts`, `PageView` tests, `packages/plugin-list` registration and README, `apps/console/src/__tests__` parity, `content/docs/plugins/plugin-list.mdx`, and the console object-list render path for item 2.

Clause-②: yes (publishes `addRecord`).

Filed from the objectui#13074 contract review (PR #13087) by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`).
